# 情シスのための Claude Code ツール

> Claude Code を社内で使う情シス・社内SE向けの無料ツール集。権限設定(settings.json)・CLAUDE.md・スキル(SKILL.md)のひな形づくり、つまずき早見表、API 料金の見積もり計算機を、ブラウザだけで使えます。

- ツールはブラウザの中だけで動き、入力した内容を外部に送りません。
- 解説記事は Claude Code の公式ドキュメントにもとづいて整理しています。仕様は変わることがあるため、最新の内容は公式ドキュメントで確認してください。
- 各ページの更新日は sitemap.xml の lastmod と、構造化データ(JSON-LD)の dateModified にあります。
- 運営: 中小DXラボ(運営者情報は about/)。

## 主要ページ

- [情シスのための Claude Code ツール](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/): Claude Code を社内で使う情シス・社内SE向けの無料ツール集。権限設定(settings.json)・CLAUDE.md・スキル(SKILL.md)のひな形づくり、つまずき早見表、API 料金の見積もり計算機を、ブラウザだけで使えます。
- [Claude Code 解説記事](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/guides/): Claude Code を社内で使う情シス・社内SE向けの解説記事の一覧です。権限設定(deny/ask/allow)、CLAUDE.md の書き方、スキル(SKILL.md)、API 料金の見積もり方、Windows でのつまずき、試す前の確認、.env の守り方、非エンジニア向けの研修の進め方を、公式ドキュメントと実機の確認結果にもとづいて解説します。
- [情シス向け Claude Code の本・有料記事 — 目的別の選び方](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/books/): Claude Code を社内で使う情シス・社内SE向けに、中小DXラボの Zenn の本と note の有料記事を目的別(稟議・セキュリティ・配布・研修・費用・定型作業の自動化)に整理しました。価格と、購入前に無料で読める範囲を載せています。

## ツール

- [Claude Code 権限設定(settings.json)ジェネレーター](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/settings-generator/): Claude Code の settings.json(権限設定)を、チェックを付けるだけで作れる無料ツール。.env を読ませない、curl などの外部送信を止める、git push は確認、を deny / ask / allow のルールで出力します。実機で止まると確認したルールを表示します。
- [CLAUDE.md テンプレート生成](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/claude-md-generator/): Claude Code の CLAUDE.md を、用途・言語・守ってほしいこと・触ってはいけないフォルダを選ぶだけで作れる無料ツール。最初の3行版にも切り替えられ、200行以内に収まっているかを行数で表示します。
- [Claude Code スキル(SKILL.md)雛形生成](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/skill-generator/): Claude Code のスキル(SKILL.md)のひな形を、スキル名・説明・いつ使うか・手順・出力の形・禁止事項を入れるだけで作れる無料ツール。スキル名の書き方と frontmatter の形を確かめ、置き場所のパスも表示します。
- [Claude Code つまずき早見表(Windows・情シス向け)](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/troubleshooting/): Claude Code を Windows で使う・社内に配るときのつまずきを、症状・原因・対処の表にまとめた早見表。allow が効かない、deny をすり抜ける、PowerShell の文字化け、CSV の BOM など、実機で起きたことだけを出典つきで載せています。
- [Claude Code API 料金 見積もり計算機(月額・円換算)](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/cost-calculator/): Claude Code を API の従量課金で使ったときの月額を、人数・1日あたりのトークン数・稼働日数・モデルから計算する無料ツール。入力・出力・キャッシュの書き込みと読み込みを分けて計算し、為替レートを入れると円でも表示します。

## English edition (/en/)

- [About, disclaimer and advertising policy](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/about/): This is the operator information for "Claude Code Tools for IT Admins," operated by Chuki DX Lab. It covers the site's purpose, how content is verified, the disclaimer, the affiliate (advertising) policy, and contact details.
- [CLAUDE.md Template Generator](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/claude-md-generator/): A free tool that builds a CLAUDE.md for Claude Code just by selecting the purpose, language, rules you want followed, and folders that must not be touched. You can also switch to the first 3-line version, and it shows the line count so you can check that it stays within 200 lines.
- [Claude Code API Cost Calculator (monthly, converted to yen)](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/cost-calculator/): A free tool that calculates the monthly cost of using Claude Code with pay-as-you-go API pricing, based on the number of users, tokens per day, working days, and model. It calculates input, output, cache writes, and cache reads separately, and also shows the result in yen if you enter an exchange rate.
- [How to Think About Generative AI Usage Rules Before Using Claude Code at a Small or Midsize Company](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/ai-usage-rules-claude-code/): For small and midsize companies, this guide organizes the generative AI usage rules to settle before using Claude Code internally: five points (permissions, external text, secrets, data handling, and sharing settings) plus the training policy for each plan.
- [Admin settings for rolling out Claude Code in an organization: how to distribute managed settings and what you can restrict](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-admin-setup/): For corporate IT admins at small and midsize companies rolling out Claude Code across an organization, this guide covers, based on the official docs, how to choose an API provider, how to distribute managed settings, what you can restrict, and how to check usage.
- [Claude Code Agent Teams: When to Use Them, How to Start, and Limits](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-agent-teams/): This guide summarizes, based on the official docs, when to use Claude Code agent teams, how they differ from subagents, how to enable them, and their limitations. It is meant as input for corporate IT before trying them internally.
- [Using AGENTS.md with Claude Code: How It Relates to CLAUDE.md and How It's Loaded](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-agents-md/): Based on the official docs, this guide covers when Claude Code reads AGENTS.md, how it behaves when CLAUDE.md also exists, switching in /config, and how to share content via import or symlink.
- [Setting Up Claude Code with Amazon Bedrock: Sign-in, IAM, and Troubleshooting](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-amazon-bedrock/): A summary of the prerequisites, sign-in steps, IAM policy, region prefixes, and troubleshooting in proxy environments for using Claude Code through Amazon Bedrock, based on the official docs.
- [How to Estimate Claude Code API Costs (Counting Tokens and Unit Prices)](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-api-cost-estimate/): How to estimate monthly cost when using Claude Code with pay-as-you-go API billing. It covers the four token types (input, cache write, cache read, output) and their unit prices (official pricing as of 2026-10-14), the formula, how to check token counts, and how it differs from a subscription.
- [Does ANTHROPIC_API_KEY switch Claude Code to API billing? How to check and remove it](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-api-key-billing/): When the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is set, Claude Code prefers the API key over the subscription, and you are billed pay-as-you-go. Based on the official docs, this covers how to check, how to remove it, and cautions.
- [How to keep Claude Code operation logs for auditing: OpenTelemetry and SIEM integration](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-audit-events/): This guide follows the official docs to cover the OpenTelemetry event types for keeping Claude Code operations as audit logs, how events are tied to users, how to configure sending to a SIEM, and what to watch for in what gets recorded.
- [Claude Code auto memory: where it's stored, how to turn it off, and how to check it](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/guides/claude-code-auto-memory/): A guide to what Claude Code's auto memory saves, where it is stored, and how to turn it off, based on the official docs. - [Claude Code Tools for IT Admins](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/): A collection of free tools for corporate IT admins and in-house SEs who use Claude Code at work. Create scaffolds for permissions (settings.json), CLAUDE.md, and skills (SKILL.md), plus a troubleshooting cheat sheet and an API cost calculator, all in the browser.
- [Claude Code Permissions (settings.json) Generator](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/settings-generator/): A free tool that builds a Claude Code settings.json (permissions) just by ticking checkboxes. It outputs deny / ask / allow rules to keep .env unreadable, block outbound transfers such as curl, and require confirmation for git push. It shows the rules I verified actually block on a real machine.
- [Claude Code Skill (SKILL.md) Scaffold Generator](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/skill-generator/): A free tool that builds a Claude Code skill (SKILL.md) scaffold from just the skill name, description, when to use it, steps, output format, and prohibitions. It checks the skill name format and frontmatter shape, and also shows the path where the file goes.
- [Claude Code Troubleshooting Cheat Sheet (for Windows and Corporate IT)](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/en/troubleshooting/): A cheat sheet of pitfalls when using Claude Code on Windows or rolling it out company-wide, organized as a table of symptom, cause, and fix. It covers only things that actually happened on a real machine, with sources: allow not taking effect, deny being bypassed, garbled PowerShell output, CSV BOMs, and more.

## Optional

- [運営者情報・免責・広告の方針](https://chuki-dx.github.io/claudecode-tools/about/): 中小DXラボが運営する「情シスのための Claude Code ツール」の運営者情報です。サイトの目的、掲載内容の確認方法、免責事項、アフィリエイト(広告)の方針、問い合わせ先を記載しています。
